1. Jonah Coleman (RB, DEN) — the league-wide #1 add this week. Both J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey are dealing with hamstring issues, and Coleman played real starter snaps in Week 2 (10 carries, 3 catches, TD). This is a competitive claim — bid near the top of your range or lose it. Drop Devaughn Vele. FAAB $18.
2. Pat Freiermuth (TE, PIT) — directly fixes your zero-depth TE problem: 9 catches, 78 yards, TD through 2 weeks with real target volume. Pittsburgh's bye isn't Week 7 like Strange's, so he doubles as a real fix for the LAC/JAX bye cluster. Drop Woody Marks (buried in Houston's committee). FAAB $9.
3. Malik Washington (WR, MIA) — Miami's unquestioned WR1 by target share now that Caleb Douglas is out with an ankle injury; a clean upgrade over Michael Wilson's committee role in Arizona. Drop Michael Wilson. FAAB $10.
Total if you take all three: $37, leaving ~$51 banked for the Week 7 bye scramble and any trade-deadline-week (Week 12) pushes.
Hold, don't drop: Tank Bigsby — Saquon Barkley's stinger/MRI has him questionable, and Bigsby would see real work if Barkley sits, in both your leagues. Zay Flowers — still DNP Wednesday on his hamstring, but worth the stash through recovery. Tyler Shough — correctly banked as your Week 7 QB fill-in since New Orleans' bye is Week 8, not 7. Jaguars DEF — still a startable matchup this week (NE implied ~20.8); revisit streaming once the Week 7 bye actually hits rather than churning the spot now.
No K stream needed — Aubrey's spot is fine.

trades.text:
SLEEPER — Send Josh Downs (WR, IND) to AdufortheWin84 (roster_id 12) for Dalton Kincaid (TE, BUF). Their roster is stacked at TE (Kincaid, Oronde Gadsden, Michael Mayer, Juwan Johnson — four tight ends for one starting slot) and QB (Prescott/Allen/Hurts), while thin at WR (Golden, London, and an Out Michael Pittman are their only real options) — Downs directly fills that hole for them. For you, Kincaid instantly upgrades your TE room from replacement-level to a weekly starter, permanently solving your thinnest position and the Week 7 bye problem (Strange is out that week too). Checked Weeks 15-17 first: this only touches a bench piece — it doesn't weaken Herbert/Hampton/Brown/Higgins/Diggs/Aubrey/Jaguars DEF for the playoff stretch, it upgrades a real weak spot. One trade-off to know before you send it: if accepted, Michael Wilson reclaims the WR2 job by default — his Week 2 line (2/18) was drawn-penalty and overthrow variance more than lost role, so that's an acceptable downgrade for a full-time starting TE. Not yet sent as of this run.
